title: Record authoring
description: Writing a product's records, and reading them back in code.

title: Product customization
description: The kinds and relations, their stages and order, the reference that shows them, and how a product adds its own.

title: Domain modeling
description: Domains by capability, and each domain's model: aggregates, entities and value objects, commands and events, rules, read models and queries.

title: Lifecycle specification
description: Business outcomes and the capabilities that serve them, use cases in capabilities and patterns, their flows, the views, endpoints and integrations they reach, the technical records that build them, the standards they meet, the tests that prove them and the data sets the tests start from.

title: Spec checking
description: Running the checks, adding new ones, reviewing what they find, and keeping every change checked.

title: Problem detection
description: The checks the schema cannot hold: records nothing uses, shape warnings, each mistake read once, and levels of the wrong size.

title: Spec reading
description: Product, domain and record pages: coverage, obligation kinds and test states, finding a record and following its links, and changing a record on its page.

title: Workspace navigation
description: One address per record, its Graph, ERD and Trace stages behind floating panels, the wiki card, the nav, quick find and keyboard shortcuts.

title: Graph exploration
description: Walking the model as a left-to-right graph with folder-like groups.

title: Workbench
description: Panels, themes, phones, stability and accessibility: what every page stands on.

title: Keyboard control
description: Commands, their keys and the hints that show them.

title: Spec serving
description: Setting Lathe up in a product's repo, loading a workspace from code, writing through one command layer, and pages that follow the data files as they change.

title: Desktop hosting
description: Opening products in windows, iterating on Lathe in the shell with hot reload, using Lathe from the native menus, a window that looks like part of Lathe, and an app that feels native on a Mac.

title: Coverage measurement
description: How much of each obligation is designed, built and proved, what is proved only by tests not automated yet, and what is still missing.

title: Test evidence
description: How a test is run, and how its file names it.

title: Coverage reporting
description: Coverage, tests by state, the patterns a domain owes and each record's traces, as the app shows them.
